title: Bed-Hold Charges Overpaid from Resident Trust Fund Accounts
content:
## Policy

When a transfer from this account paid a bed-hold charge in full and the charge billed more than the hold's own rules let it bill, the bed-hold office can no longer reduce that charge, so the part of the transfer that paid the excess is returned to the account with the reason wrong amount, naming the transfer, within the improper charge reversal business days.

"This account" is the resident's Resident Trust Fund Accounts account; the bed-hold charge sits on a reservation under Bed-Hold and Leave Reservations. The return applies in every tier of the resident funds account.

## Business effect

The return is one entry on the resident funds account's ledger that names the bed-hold transfer being given back and the reason it was improper, dated the day it is processed. It raises the account balance by the amount returned, and every later lookup shows the higher balance.

## Recording the return: `return_bed_hold_overcharge_0789df0a`

This is an agent-side tool. It is not in the default tool list: unlock it first, then call it.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `trust_account_id` | the resident funds account the money goes back into, as shown on the account record | identifier |
| `withdrawal_entry_id` | the bed-hold transfer entry being given back, as shown on that entry's line in the account's ledger | identifier |
| `reversal_reason` | why the transfer was improper | one of the four values below |
| `amount` | the money returned to the account | US dollars, a positive decimal number with 2 decimal places, rounded half up to the cent, no currency sign |

Values of `reversal_reason`:
- `payer_covered_item` — it paid for an item or service that Medicare or Medical Assistance covers;
- `unauthorized` — it was made without the written authority the account requires;
- `duplicate` — it repeated a ledger entry that paid the same thing;
- `amount_error` — it paid more than the charge owed, for the wrong amount.

**Return.** A one-line confirmation of the form "Returned <amount> USD to account <account> for bed-hold transfer <transfer entry> (<reason>) as entry <new entry>; new balance <balance> USD." The presence of the new entry's reference number shows that the return was recorded.

## Contract Q&A

**Does the tool reduce the bed-hold charge itself?** No. It records a return on the resident funds account only; the bed-hold charge is not changed.
